skill.name: Jakarta EE Package Import Migration
skill.description: Systematically update Java import statements from `javax.*` to `jakarta.*` packages when upgrading to Spring Boot 3.0 and Jakarta EE 10. Use automated tools to identify and replace all affected imports across the codebase.
skill.skill_body:
When upgrading to Spring Boot 3.0, Jakarta EE 10 requires namespace changes from javax to jakarta packages. Use OpenRewrite recipes, Spring Boot Migrator, or IntelliJ IDEA migration support to automatically scan and replace all javax.* imports with jakarta.* equivalents. Verify compilation succeeds and no javax references remain.

## Objective

Complete javax-to-jakarta package namespace migration
## Applicable Signals

- Build configuration updated to Spring Boot 3.0
- Compilation errors referencing javax packages
- Dependency manifest shows Jakarta EE 10

## Contraindications

- Application already uses jakarta packages exclusively
- No javax imports present in codebase
- Targeting Spring Boot 2.7.x or earlier versions

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Select migration tool', 'detail': 'Choose OpenRewrite recipes, Spring Boot Migrator, or IntelliJ IDEA migration support based on project setup'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Scan codebase', 'detail': 'Run tool to identify all javax.* package references in import statements'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Execute replacement', 'detail': 'Apply automated transformation to replace javax.* with jakarta.* across all source files'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify compilation', 'detail': 'Compile project and confirm no import-related errors remain'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Validate completeness', 'detail': 'Search codebase for any remaining javax package references; confirm none exist'}

## Constraints

- All source files must be scanned for javax references
- Automated tool must support the project's build system (Maven/Gradle)
- Migration must complete before compilation validation

## Cautions

- Some custom or legacy libraries may not have jakarta equivalents; verify third-party dependencies support Jakarta EE 10
- Manual review recommended for edge cases where automated tools cannot determine correct replacement

## Output Contract

- All javax.* imports replaced with jakarta.* equivalents
- Project compiles without import-related errors
- No javax package references remain in source code
